lines:
+                'description' => "DSN used by the Open Runtimes executor for function/site build and source storage (`OPR_EXECUTOR_CONNECTION_STORAGE`). Defaults to local filesystem storage.

Examples:
- Local: `local://localhost`
- AWS S3: `s3://ACCESS_KEY:SECRET@BUCKET.s3.REGION.amazonaws.com?region=REGION`
- S3-compatible (MinIO, etc.): `s3://ACCESS_KEY:SECRET@localhost/BUCKET?region=REGION&url=http%3A%2F%2Fminio%3A9000`

When Appwrite uses a remote `_APP_STORAGE_DEVICE`, set this DSN to the same backend so the executor can read deployment artifacts. See the [open-runtimes/executor](https://github.com/open-runtimes/executor) README for DSN details.",

'description' => 'The Docker volume (or Kubernetes PersistentVolumeClaim) holding build storage, attached to jobs-service build workers so they write output directly onto it. Must match the storage the "builds" device is backed by.',
